assessment_summary: In order to show that the mapping \phi \restriction_{S_1 \times S_3} : S_1 \to S_3 is arbitrary join preserving, the proof must begin by taking an arbitrary subset of the domain S_1. However, step 0029 incorrectly introduces 'A \subseteq S_3' (a subset of the codomain). This leads to a type error in step 0033 which attempts to take the supremum of A in the lattice L_1. Therefore, 0029 is the first flawed step because it introduces a variable from the wrong set.
